name: Kitagata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitagata town emblem in green: a stylised device of curled strokes, like the character 北.
history: Municipal flag of Kitagata, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1889.

features.role: Kitagata town emblem — a stylised device of curled strokes, like the character 北
